description: F1 states the incident occurred around 2:15 PM (repeated in three sections). F10 (Marcus) says it happened closer to 3:00 PM, right after shift change. These conflict.
F5 says the certification had lapsed and was pending renewal. F9 (Dana) and F14 (records + HR file) say it was current through March 2027. Direct conflict.
F2 states two employees witnessed the incident. F17 (Danvers's email) names three people on the floor near Aisle 4 (Dana, Marcus, Priya). The count and the named list don't match.

F11 (Marcus) says the rail had been loose for weeks. F13 (maintenance log) says it was inspected and confirmed secure at 9:00 AM the morning of the incident. Not clear from these two claims alone whether the rail was actually secure by 2:15 PM.
F16 (Danvers) says the alarm sounded immediately. F12 (Marcus) and F18 (Okafor) both say it did not sound. Direct conflict.
